honest_c3: C3-1 inline-replication of engine algorithms (top-level _selftest() in upstream engines fires on import + name collisions on `step`, `_selftest`, `fabs_f`, `TWO_PI`, `PI`); if upstream engines change, this v2 demo must be re-synced (no shared lib import yet)
C3-2 adapter A uses a fixed phase-kick amplitude (PHASE_KICK_RAD=0.15); biologically more accurate would scale amplitude by ISI or recent firing rate
C3-3 adapter B is linear in phase variance with a hard normalizer; physically there are many defensible mappings (Kuramoto coherence (1-r), entropy, sin² of phase spread, etc.)
C3-4 stage 3 quantum substrate is 2-qubit only (single g across cells); a true 8-cell quantum chain would be 256-dim Hilbert space and beyond closed-form 2x2 block evolution

C3-5 F-E2E-CROSS-2 (monotone) is checked at synthetic variance probes (0.1 vs 3.0) rather than via two real-spike-pattern runs, because with supra-critical I=15.0 every SNN cell saturates and coupling adds no extra spikes (cells already refractory) — physics, not a bug, but means the monotone claim is tested at adapter B in isolation
C3-6 the chain is one-directional (no feedback from quantum back to photonic or SNN); a full closed loop would require an additional quantum-readout->SNN-drive adapter

C3-7 PRNG: SNN noise via lcg_rand01 (k_scale=0 in primary run so coupling is identically 0), photonic noise amp=0, quantum is closed-form (deterministic) — entire chain is deterministic by construction, which is why CROSS-4 expects byte-equal psi
key_learning: cross-engine substrate-bridging via typed-flat adapters (bool[] → float[] → float scalar → real coupling) is sufficient to plumb 3 heterogeneous physics engines into a single pipeline; the determinism check (CROSS-4 byte-equal psi over repeat) is the strongest single signal that the chain is well-defined end-to-end
